title: Memorial Acclamation C
text:
Save us, Savior of the world,
for by your Cross and Resurrection
you have set us free.

translation.latin:
Salvator mundi, salva nos,
qui per crucem et resurrectionem tuam
liberasti nos.

notes: This third Memorial Acclamation directly addresses Christ as 'Savior of the world' and proclaims that through His Cross and Resurrection, He has set us free. It emphasizes the soteriological (salvation) aspect of the Paschal Mystery and our liberation through Christ's sacrifice.
description: Save us, Savior of the world
